landmarks.name: Paved pit lane and working apron
landmarks.source_note: The retained pit compound 144362327 spans approximately native 5425–227 m across zero. The actual 33-bay garage front spans approximately 5486–207 m and lies 9.784–10.300 m beyond the current road edge. Paving extends 10.35 m to meet that frontage; up to 0.57 m lies under the building edge. The rounded control/timing end projects farther toward the apron and remains occupied architecture. Registration and OSM footprint uncertainty are about 2 m; interval ends are rounded by at most 7 m. Paving remains visual beyond the closed pit wall, with no pit access functionality. See pit-roof-review.json.

landmarks.source: Operator architecture photograph; actual mapped circular end outline. Roof height/radial section, pier and spire dimensions are visual estimates, not a structural survey. Native5060 forward camera misses the crown; no relocation is made for that view.

landmarks.name: Sepang mapped double-frontage palm-leaf grandstand
landmarks.dimensions_status: Actual concave wing outlines and open central mall gaps retained, with 3 m road clearance. Each wing follows adjacent retained road/concourse floor grade, not roof-contaminated DSM. White membrane modules retain the actual concave footprint and open central mall. Low front edges and rising rear fabric are supported by visible branching ribs below each canopy and rear masts. Bay spacing around 25 m, front spring 18.5 m and rib thickness are unmeasured reconstructions from supplied 122/130/134 s and the operator architecture photo; no road profile or global material changes.

landmarks.name: F Grandstand
landmarks.structure: Closed concrete treads and risers, end walls, sloping soffit, grounded braced rear columns and two-sided roof soffit.

landmarks.name: K1 Grandstand
landmarks.structure: Footprint-clipped curved terraces on local front-edge ground; road-facing boundary chains and inward rows retain the mapped grass interior.

landmarks.name: Sepang mapped pit garages and white upper cantilever terraces
landmarks.dimensions_status: Mapped 345 m compound replaces an invented 573 m generic building. Operator specifies 33 garages 8 m wide and 24 m deep, three office/paddock levels and a refurbished roof terrace. White body, narrower window bands, exposed terrace edges and pale roof/soffits match supplied122/126/130/134 s. Roof profiles and support spacing are explicitly reconstructed estimates; footprint, whole-road clearance and adjacent road-grade foundation are retained.
